description: An open-air sea-level beach camp with its own moored Greek galley: sand shore rising from a ragged tide line, a campfire ring with log benches (the relight fixture), two wool/fence A-frame tents, a barrel supply stack, a lantern class post, and a jetty + walkable gangplank that boards the galley anchored just offshore in authored ocean (deck lanterns for the dusk beat). The entry set-piece for the nobodys-cave-island remake, with a tutorial surf-wave spawn on dry sand at the water's edge. The galley is stamped into this piece (not a separate area) because the DSL has no scenery-offset primitive and the solver spaces areas 256 blocks apart, so an offshore ship must live inside the beach piece to be 'just offshore'.

tags.era_style: bronze-age Aegean shore camp + Greek galley, vanilla carpentry

style_fit.rationale: The purpose-built sea-level entry for the nobodys-cave-island remake (spec-0013): sand shore, class-selection spot, crew mannequin stands, and the escape-promise Greek galley moored offshore from minute one, boarded over a walkable gangplank (anchor/deck, anchor/prow). Flood-safe by construction (walk plane one block above the waterline; the galley hull is stamped over the beach's own sea so there is one water body), so the tutorial surf-wave anchor is dry standable sand and the gangplank is DW0311-walkable end to end. Open-air, sky-lit, renders clean at 1.21.11.
